Workflows.title: Search and View Image Details
Workflows.goal: Search for a specific topic and view the high-resolution image page. Success: Image detail page loads with download options.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Type 'nature' into the search input field
3. Press Enter to search
4. Click on any image in the search results grid
5. Verify the image detail view opens with the 'Download free' button visible. (Note: May be blocked by bot protection)

Workflows.title: Help Center License Search
Workflows.goal: Find specific licensing information using the Help Center search. Success: Article content is displayed.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://help.unsplash.com/en/
2. Type 'license' into the 'Search for articles...' input field
3. Click the 'Unsplash License' collection card
4. Click the article link 'What is the Unsplash+ License?'
5. Verify the article content and breadcrumb navigation are present.

Workflows.title: Filter Blog by Category and Read Article
Workflows.goal: Filter the Unsplash blog by a specific category and open an article. Success: Article page loads with correct content.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/blog
2. Click 'Product' in the top navigation menu
3. Click on any article title or the 'Read:' link (e.g., 'You can now filter your illustration search by style')
4. Verify the full article content and author attribution are displayed.

Workflows.title: Access Developer API Documentation
Workflows.goal: Navigate from the developer portal to the technical API documentation. Success: Documentation site loads.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click the 'View the documentation' button
3. Verify the browser navigates to the Unsplash API documentation page.

Workflows.title: Download Unsplash Lite Dataset
Workflows.goal: Access the open-source dataset for research or development. Success: Redirected to the dataset repository.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click 'Dataset' in the navigation or body
3. On the https://unsplash.com/data page, click 'Download' under the Lite dataset section
4. Verify redirection to the GitHub repository (github.com/unsplash/datasets).

Workflows.title: Check API System Status
Workflows.goal: Verify the operational status of the Unsplash API. Success: Status page shows system health.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click 'API Status' in the footer or resource links
3. Verify the status page (status.unsplash.com) loads and shows system operational status.
